controls: Authorization for NEW isolated project (not archived branch)
Acceptance of owner/master personal-data residency in Singapore
Allowed runtime network ingress model and verified TLS hostname
Appropriate managed secret custody, independent backup and separate restore destination
Separate role/key enrollment and P3 installation admission

critical_before_creation: Neon FREE plan only short restore history; independent encrypted pg_dump + separate restore is mandatory before owner data entry
Provider root admin must NOT be used as HFT runtime or operational signer
Cloud provider may select PostgreSQL 18 minor version other than 18.6; exact SQL server_version_num=180006 is independent runtime gate
Public network access is not approved by omission: security must accept public endpoint+TLS+least-privileged login or select privately reachable alternative
hard_bans: Installing P3 before role/key/crypto/canonical source admission
Real owner data prior to backup+restore test

estimated_cost.within_current_free_quota: USD 0 if usage within 100 CU-hours/project/month and 1 GB storage
estimated_cost.not_included: backup object storage/restore compute, egress exceptions, taxes, snapshot/history, overages
